cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.
